messages:
maria (Finance): FYI last night's nightly-cost-alerts flagged ~$18k untagged GPU spend across asia-west. granularity shows 3 big bursts between 01:10–02:00 UTC.
ken (ML infra): Ugh. Those hours line up with a scheduled hyperparam sweep that should have been tagged to team:recs-alpha.
sachin (SRE): Do we have run IDs? I can correlate with infra logs quickly.
maria (Finance): I pulled a quick query, see snippet: 
```sql
select run_id, start_ts, cost_usd, tags from gpu_billing where ts between '2026-03-22 01:00' and '2026-03-22 03:00' and tags is null;
```
ken (ML infra): Run IDs: r-83f, r-83g, r-83h — those are from the autoscheduler. Looks like a config drift where the tagging hook failed.
lucy (Eng-platform): Tagging hook? Could be the rollout of the new autoscaler image yesterday. I rolled back the image at 04:30 UTC but too late for those runs.
olivia (Product): Which customers were affected? Any external bill exposure?
maria (Finance): All internal / sandbox projects except one burst mapped to customer:acme-proto (small, ~$2.4k). We should decide if we credit them.
ken (ML infra): For internal sandboxes my preference is to attribute to the Platform budget to avoid breaking team SLAs. For acme-proto — open to refund or credit, need PM signoff.
maria (Finance): Proposed immediate actions: 1) Tag the 3 runs retroactively to team:recs-alpha or platform as appropriate, 2) Issue a provisional credit to acme-proto pending product decision, 3) Create a short-term alert to catch tagging-hook failures.
sachin (SRE): I can add the alert: term: 'gpu_tag_fail_rate', threshold: 3 failed tag events / 1h. Will set PagerDuty to eng-platform on-call.
lucy (Eng-platform): +1. Also adding a one-time backfill job to fix historical rows. SQL I propose: 
```sql
update gpu_billing set tags = 'team:recs-alpha' where run_id in ('r-83f','r-83g') and tags is null;
update gpu_billing set tags = 'customer:acme-proto' where run_id = 'r-83h' and tags is null;
```
maria (Finance): Sounds good. For accounting I'll need a comment field and an approval chain. Can you put the reason + rollback note in the update?
lucy (Eng-platform): I'll include a comment and link to the rollback PR.
olivia (Product): For acme-proto, recommend a $2.4k credit and a one-off postmortem note to the customer. I'm okay with the credit. Approving now.
maria (Finance): Approved by Product (olivia). tagging backfill + credit action item logged.
billing-bot: Created ticket BF-2026-047 in billing-backfill, assigned to lucy. Estimated time: 45m.
ken (ML infra): Quick note: let's add a guard in the autoscheduler so new runs fail fast if tag handshake fails (instead of spinning for hours). I'll open a tiny PR.
sachin (SRE): I'll own the alert and PD escalation. lucy can own backfill + deployment rollback note. maria will own credit ticket and GL adjustments.
maria (Finance): I'll post the cost impact summary to the monthly GPU spend dashboard and mark these as 'manual adjustment' + reference BF-2026-047.
olivia (Product): Thanks all. Can we confirm once backfill completes?
lucy (Eng-platform): Will ping this thread when BF ticket closes.
ken (ML infra): PR: https://git.internal/repo/autoscheduler/pulls/552 (guard + tagging retry).
maria (Finance): Closing loop: provisional credit queued, awaiting invoice audit. keep thread for closure. :thumbsup:
